trap: The short way is a corridor twelve cells above the entry floor that ends at two shotgunners; a gunpowder barrel stands a few cells in front of them. The long way drops through a hole in the entry floor into a lane under the floor, three times as long, with a Hämis and a potion
cue: The raised corridor is out of sight until the player climbs onto its ledge; the guards and the barrel show in the entity list once seen; the hole is plain in the floor; a Fireball spell lies at the foot of the ledge and the guards stand on a brick floor
notes: Light the barrel with the Fireball from the ledge (the spark bolt does not hurt a barrel) to kill both guards, or take the long way. Gate (routes.py): short_gate (the corridor above the guards' brick floor) or long_route (the lane); either is a way through. A brick pier under the west end of the guards' floor seals the block of ground between the corridor and the lane.

lessons.note: A gunpowder barrel explodes when fire reaches it and kills whoever is near
A fireball sets things on fire: you can set off a gunpowder barrel from a distance
